leaders.bio: The Premier remains the elected head of the Government and the highest authority within the executive branch. The Premier establishes the Government's overall direction, appoints senior government officials (below State Presidium Level) at will and ensures the implementation of the Government's program. He can also make decrees which can change the server in any way shape or form.

leaders.bio: Deputy Premiers (a collective) constitute the senior leadership of the Government. They oversee major "spheres" of administration and ensure their "spheres" remain active and working. Deputy Premiers are permanent, non-elective positions and shall be appointed (through task completions) from among members of the State Presidium.

leaders.bio: The First Deputy Premier is the highest ranking permanent official within the Government. The office is non elective and is selected from amongst the Deputy Premiers. The First Deputy Premier assists the Premier in directing the Government, coordinates the Deputy Premiers, is the highest ranking permanent official in the government and assumes responsibility for the administration of the Government when delegated by the Premier. Can also be given special tasks, work and to-dos by the General Secretary
leaders.name: - VACANT -

leaders.bio: The State Presidium constitutes the permanent senior executive establishment of the USSR. Members of the Presidium supervise major areas of Government and coordinate multiple Commissariats within their respective spheres. Membership in the State Presidium represents a significant advancement within the state apparatus and is a permanent position rather than an electoral office. Members who do exceptionally well as Council of People's Commissars get automatically promoted to the State Presidium.
leaders.name: - VACANT -
